memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine
- Status: Patient reports 4-5 headache days per month, moderate intensity, responds partially to sumatriptan SOS.
- Plan: Continue propranolol 40 mg OD for prevention; advise sumatriptan 50 mg SOS max 2 doses/24h; consider topiramate 25 mg HS if needed.
Irritable bowel syndrome
- Status: Abdominal pain 2-3 days/week, bloating, alternating constipation/diarrhea; currently on mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS.
- Plan: Continue current regimen; advise regular fluid intake and low‑FODMAP diet trial.
Weight 68 kg, waist 92 cm (above male cut‑off 90 cm). Advise reduced saturated fat, increase walking.
Due: HbA1c 2025-07-05.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Propranolol 40 mg 1-0-0 after food; Sumatriptan 50 mg SOS after food; Topiramate 25 mg 0-0-1 after food; Mebeverine 135 mg 1-0-1 after food; Ispaghula husk 5 g 1-0-0 with water; Loperamide 2 mg SOS after food.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Stool routine: Colour brown, consistency formed, pus cells 0‑1/hpf, RBC 0‑1/hpf, no ova or cysts.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Neurological examination: No focal deficits, normal gait, mild bilateral temporal tenderness, otherwise normal.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: CT head (non‑contrast): No acute infarct, hemorrhage or mass; ventricles normal size; reported as normal.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine
- Status: Headache days reduced to 2‑3/month; sumatriptan used ≤2 times/week; mild scalp tenderness.
- Plan: Continue propranolol 40 mg OD; increase topiramate to 50 mg HS; keep sumatriptan SOS.
Irritable bowel syndrome
- Status: Pain 1‑2 days/week, bloating less; stool pattern improved with ispaghula.
- Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD; reduce loperamide to SOS only; maintain ispaghula husk 5 g OD.
Weight 67 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off). Advise maintain activity.
Due: HbA1c 2025-10-10.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 6.0 % (4.0‑5.6); Total cholesterol 190 mg/dl (<200); HDL 45 mg/dl (>40); LDL 110 mg/dl (<130); Triglycerides 150 mg/dl (<150).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve had three migraine attacks in the past week, each lasting about 6 hours, and I’ve needed sumatriptan twice. My bowel symptoms are fine, just occasional bloating after meals.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine
- Status: Increased frequency – 3 attacks/week, sumatriptan use 4‑5 times/week, mild nausea.
- Plan: Stop sumatriptan due to overuse; start propranolol increase to 60 mg OD; add amitriptyline 10 mg HS for prophylaxis (off‑label).
Irritable bowel syndrome
- Status: Stable, no worsening.
- Plan: Continue current IBS meds.
Weight 66 kg, waist 89 cm (below cut‑off).
Due: HbA1c 2026-01-08.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine
- Status: Headache days down to 1‑2/week after propranolol up‑titration and amitriptyline; no sumatriptan used in past 2 weeks.
- Plan: Continue propranolol 60 mg OD; continue amitriptyline 10 mg HS; keep topiramate 50 mg HS.
Irritable bowel syndrome
- Status: No pain, regular bowel movements.
- Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD; ispaghula husk 5 g OD; loperamide SOS only if needed.
Weight 65 kg, waist 88 cm.
Due: HbA1c 2026-04-20.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Migraine
- Status: Well‑controlled – ≤1 headache/month, no acute meds needed.
- Plan: Continue propranolol 60 mg OD; consider tapering amitriptyline after 3 months if sustained.
Irritable bowel syndrome
- Status: Asymptomatic.
- Plan: Continue mebeverine 135 mg BD; ispaghula husk 5 g OD; loperamide only SOS.
Weight 64 kg, waist 86 cm.
Due: HbA1c 2027-01-30 (beyond window, but noted).
